outcome: A run whose authority is a bootstrap-approved plan digest stops burning a turn on a planner dispatch no proposal it produces can ever clear, and stops that park from going invisible to every status reader: when NextRole is planner - from either a slice's captain-escalate or verifier-blocked (internal/baton/state.go:2959-2960, :2968-2969) or, when no slice carries it, the assembly's own verifier-blocked (state.go:3948-3958, reached once every track's slices have already passed, :3859-3877) - and BootstrapApprovedPlanDigest (internal/runtime/manifest.go:95) is the run's only authority, driveLoop parks the run under a new ParkCauseBootstrapAuthority instead of dispatching the planner, with a reason built from the triggering receipt's Summary (internal/baton/receipts.go:29-49, populated at state.go:2947 for a slice or state.go:3957 for the assembly) verbatim plus a fixed operator-path sentence, and RunStatus (internal/runtime/status.go) surfaces that cause and reason on every read - closing sworn#259 (a bootstrap-authority run admits a revision proposal it can never approve: run-start refuses it PLAN_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT at internal/runtime/scheduler.go:6998-7004 whenever the proposal's digest disagrees with the fixed bootstrap digest it can never equal, and sworn approve refuses it APPROVAL_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT at internal/runtime/approval.go:364-370) and sworn#278 in the narrow sense that no in-run proposal is attempted under bootstrap authority (the planner cannot compute the canonical contract digest the fence requires - internal/baton/plan.go:972-1083 - and no worker tool returns it, internal/driver/tools.go:45); today internal/runtime/scheduler.go:5690-5695 and :5698-5706 dispatch driver.RolePlanner unconditionally via proposeRevision (:6529-6537) -> proposePlan (:6398-6406) -> proposePlanAttempt (:6408-6527) -> dispatchRoleWithScope (:6493-6495) whenever any slice or the assembly carries NextRole planner, and RunStatus has no boolean input that knows this condition at all - a dispatch observed in the fired r1 journal as a planner yielding a human attention it has no legitimate way to answer into approval and in r2 as a turn spent bisecting INVALID_PLAN_BYTES, a park that an incomplete fix would leave structurally invisible to sworn status, the TUI, and internal/cockpit.

exclude: the state machine's derivations (internal/baton/state.go:2959-2960 captain/escalate, :2968-2969 verifier/blocked, and deriveAssembly's verifier/blocked branch at :3948-3958) - all three keep producing NextRole planner and CurrentReceipt exactly as today; this slice changes only driveLoop's reaction and RunStatus's reading, never what deriveSlice/deriveAssembly compute

exposing the canonical slice digest to planners (internal/baton/plan.go:972-1083 validateSliceBody, internal/driver/tools.go:45 sworn_submit schema) - no tool gains a digest-returning capability; sworn#278 closes here only in the sense that no in-run proposal is attempted under bootstrap authority

the run-start and approval refusal codes (PLAN_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT at scheduler.go:6998-7004, APPROVAL_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT at approval.go:364-370) stay exactly as they are, as the backstop for any proposal admitted despite this slice

the human-confirmed-planner-handoff gate (turn_recovery.go:2168-2198 validateHumanConfirmedPlannerHandoff) is unmodified; this slice prevents the dispatch that would need it under bootstrap authority, it does not change the gate itself

internal/cockpit (projector.go, webhook.go, presentation.go) is unmodified - these already render whatever RunStatus().Park.Cause and .Reason return; teaching RunStatus about the new cause and reason is sufficient, and no cockpit rendering path needs its own change

acceptance.text: driveLoop stops dispatching the planner whenever the effective plan authority is purely bootstrap-seeded, from either source that sets plannerNeeded: a slice's NextRole=="planner" (internal/baton/state.go:2959-2960 sets it on captain/escalate, :2968-2969 on verifier/blocked, with CurrentReceipt populated at :2947) or, when no slice carries it, the assembly's own NextRole=="planner" (deriveAssembly's verifier/blocked branch, state.go:3948-3958, which sets NextRole at :3955 and populates AssemblyState.CurrentReceipt - not any SliceState.CurrentReceipt - at :3957, reached once every track's slices have already passed, :3859-3877 allPassed). Today scheduler.go:5615-5620 folds both sources into one plannerNeeded bool with no reference to BootstrapApprovedPlanDigest (manifest.go:95) or effectivePlanAuthority (scheduler.go:5969-5992), and both call sites - :5690-5695 (reached when this round's ready work existed but none of it progressed) and :5698-5706 (reached when there was no ready work at all) - unconditionally call s.proposeRevision (:6529-6537), which calls proposePlan (:6398-6406) then proposePlanAttempt (:6408-6527), dispatching driver.RolePlanner via dispatchRoleWithScope at :6493-6495. After this slice, a single shared predicate (used identically by driveLoop and by RunStatus, per A2) reports the run bootstrap-parked whenever BootstrapApprovedPlanDigest is set and no plan_authority command has been journaled (scheduler.go:5978-5992), and driveLoop returns from both call sites without invoking proposeRevision whenever that predicate holds. Pinned by three scheduler tests: (1) a captain/escalate slice under a bootstrap-only manifest asserting zero driver.RolePlanner invocations; (2) every track's slices passed and the assembly reaching verifier/blocked under the same bootstrap-only manifest, asserting the recorded park reason derives from state.Assembly.CurrentReceipt with zero driver.RolePlanner invocations; (3) a second track carrying a ready slice whose advanceSlice call this round returns EFFECT_PARKED (an already-claimed dispatch) run concurrently with a captain/escalate slice, asserting driveLoop reaches the :5690-5695 branch and still records zero driver.RolePlanner invocations under bootstrap-only authority.

The parked run names why, how to unstick it, and that naming survives to every status reader, not just the journal. No proposal a planner produces under a pure bootstrap authority can be approved: run-start refuses a mismatched digest PLAN_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT (scheduler.go:6998-7004) and sworn approve refuses it APPROVAL_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT (approval.go:364-370), a conflict a bootstrap-only proposal can never resolve since the digest was fixed before the planner ran. After this slice: (1) driveLoop appends one typed event under a new ParkCauseBootstrapAuthority constant (degradation.go:47-70 block, additive) exactly once per run, guarded by hasParkEventForCause/appendParkEventOnce (economy_guards.go:556-574/:530-545) in the same once-per-cause pattern scheduler.go:5588-5602 already uses for degradation, so a re-entering driveLoop, or the triggering receipt changing from captain/escalate to verifier/blocked on a later pass, never writes a second event for this cause. (2) The reason is the triggering receipt's Summary (receipts.go:29-49) verbatim - including any interior newline or control character it already carries, since validCaptainDecisionText (internal/runtime/captain_decision.go:195-197) enforces only non-empty, bounded length, valid UTF-8, and strings.TrimSpace equality, never a control-character ban - followed by a blank line and the fixed literal "Revise the contract, run sworn plan record to record the next revision, then relaunch the run." This literal, not a paraphrase, is what a test asserts byte-for-byte; the field carrying it must never pass through validParkDetail (degradation.go:241-254), which rejects characters below 0x20 and would corrupt a multi-line Summary. (3) RunStatus (status.go) reports State=="parked" with Park.Cause==ParkCauseBootstrapAuthority and Park.Reason set once this condition holds, in the steady state where no plan proposal exists (proposalFound false, since this slice prevents one from ever being produced). This is the load-bearing gap today: status.go's State switch at :359-386 sets "parked" at :377-378 from a `parked` value that, when no proposal exists, was computed at :245-246 - before baton.ReadState even runs (:258) - from only attentionParked (:92, set at :105-108) and degradationBudgetExceeded (:203); the later recompute at :472-473 is guarded by :474's `!parked`, so it only ever refines an already-not-parked verdict into a more specific state (awaiting_approval/complete/takeover_required) and can never retroactively turn a "running" already assigned at :384-385 into "parked". A fix wired only into :472-473/:495-507 therefore reproduces the exact invisibility this slice exists to close; the new condition must be known in time to affect :245-246/:359-386 on the no-proposal path. Pinned by: a scheduler test asserting the recorded park event's cause and byte-exact reason over a Summary containing an embedded newline; a scheduler re-entry test asserting a second driveLoop pass appends no second event for the same cause; and a status-level test, with no plan proposal recorded, asserting RunStatus(runID).State=="parked" and .Park.Cause/.Reason match once the park event's triggering condition holds.

A recorded plan_authority command keeps today's dispatch, for either trigger source and both dispatch sites A1 changes. Once an operator has journaled a plan_authority command (scheduler.go:5978-5992, written by sworn plan record, cmd/sworn/plan_command.go:41,119-127) the shared predicate from A1/A2 no longer reports bootstrap-only authority, and driveLoop dispatches the planner exactly as it does today from both :5690-5695 and :5698-5706 - proposeRevision runs and dispatchRoleWithScope invokes driver.RolePlanner (:6493-6495). Pinned by two scheduler tests: one with a plan_authority command recorded, asserting the fake driver DOES receive a driver.RolePlanner invocation under the same captain/escalate slice state A1's first test parks; and one asserting the same under the same all-passed/assembly-verifier-blocked state A1's second test parks.

An ordinary externally-approved run is unaffected, regardless of which source sets plannerNeeded. A manifest whose Authority carries no BootstrapApprovedPlanDigest at all (only ExternalAuthorizer, manifest.go:93-95) dispatches the planner unconditionally on plannerNeeded exactly as scheduler.go:5690-5706 does today, whether the trigger is a slice's captain/escalate or verifier/blocked (state.go:2959-2960, :2968-2969) or the assembly's own verifier/blocked (state.go:3948-3958) - the new gate must key off BootstrapApprovedPlanDigest specifically and never fire for the ordinary human-approval path, and RunStatus must never report ParkCauseBootstrapAuthority for such a run. Pinned by a scheduler test with no BootstrapApprovedPlanDigest set asserting the fake driver still receives the driver.RolePlanner invocation, and a status-level test on the same run asserting RunStatus(runID).Park is nil or carries a cause other than ParkCauseBootstrapAuthority.

constraints: The state machine's derivations are frozen: deriveSlice's captain/escalate and verifier/blocked cases (state.go:2959-2960, :2968-2969) and deriveAssembly's verifier/blocked case (state.go:3948-3958), and their NextRole planner outcome and CurrentReceipt population, are untouched; this slice changes only driveLoop's reaction to a planner-needed state and RunStatus's reading of it.

No new terminal outcome or decision vocabulary is introduced: ParkCauseBootstrapAuthority is one more entry alongside the existing ParkCause* string constants (degradation.go:47-70), and ParkStatus gains one additive Reason field (service.go:163-177); neither SliceState nor AssemblyState gains a new Status or Outcome value.

The gate is one predicate over BootstrapApprovedPlanDigest (manifest.go:95) and any recorded plan_authority command (scheduler.go:5978-5992), with a single implementation driveLoop and RunStatus both call - never two independent recomputations that can drift. In RunStatus it must be evaluated in time to affect the State switch at status.go:359-386 (which sets "parked" at :377-378) on the no-proposal path, not only the later :472-473 recompute, which a `!parked` guard at :474 can only use to refine an already-not-parked verdict. A manifest with neither signal, or one superseded by a plan_authority command, dispatches the planner exactly as today.
PLAN_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT (scheduler.go:6998-7004) and APPROVAL_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT (approval.go:364-370) remain in force, unweakened, as the backstop for any proposal admitted despite this slice.

The park reason is exactly the triggering receipt's Summary field verbatim - including any interior control character or newline, never sanitized through validParkDetail (degradation.go:241-254) - followed by a blank line and the fixed literal this contract names, written at most once per run under the existing hasParkEventForCause/appendParkEventOnce discipline (economy_guards.go:556-574/:530-545, the pattern scheduler.go:5588-5602 already applies to degradation). No secret or credential ever flows through it beyond what the Summary already carried.
